<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Build the deterministic harness surface pij workteam verbs will call to detect a stream that never produced a flight plan or a valid plan document: bundle flight-plan as a first-class flow type (so harness flow create flight-plan works bare, without the builder skill installed), then add a flow-family check verb that answers two clauses in one envelope — the plan validates (error when absent or invalid) and a flight plan exists and is readable (warning when missing, per Jordan's ruling). Built red-first against fixtures shaped like pij wave streams 098/099 (the real measured failure: 0/9 flight plans, 2/9 no plan document, 9/9 merged green — #140, AI-Substrate/pij#227), and closed with a pij-facing contract plus a handoff and collaboration offer to ermine, whose team wires it into pij workteam.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- pij workteam verbs can detect a stream with no flight plan or an invalid/missing plan document by calling one deterministic harness verb, per-stream, post-hoc, on any worktree
- harness flow create flight-plan works bare (no --schema/--template, no builder skill installed) — flight-plan becomes a bundled first-class flow type (fixes the E304 friction, F-15)
- missing flight plan reports as a WARNING (degraded, exit 0) by default; missing/invalid plan document reports as an ERROR (exit 1) — Jordans ruled polarity
- the verb counts what was examined and excluded, never only what survived
- a written pij-facing contract plus a handoff and collaboration offer delivered to ermine (who wires pij using their own workteam)

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- no wiring into harness checks — ruled out: builder is one SDD flavour among several (OpenSpec etc.)
- no nudge mechanism — explicitly deferred until the prompting-in-skills experiment runs
- no changes to plan validate / plan ready semantics or envelopes (plan 072 polarity preserved; s080 parity AC) and no edits to acts/plan/index.ts, services/dd/**, acts/dd/**
- no pij-repo edits EXCEPT the granted convergence path: DELTA blocks into docs/how/fleet/stand-up.md on branch docs/fleet-live-findings (grant: prime + ermine convergence rule, 2026-08-09 — divergences go back to that file as edits, never a second doc here); all other pij surfaces are propose-and-hand-off only and ~/pi-hacking/pij-worktrees/ stays read-only
- no enforcement of builder outside workteam context

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Incorporates findings from assets/research-dossier.md (15 findings, 4 historical learnings). Keys: both clauses already have deterministic primitives — plan validate goes E400/exit 1 on the 098/099 shape today, and readFlowDoc (services/flow/flow-service.ts:100-134) distinguishes E301 missing / E300 malformed / E308 legacy / E306 future-version flows. plan ready is 80% of the wanted verb but plan 072 AC-06 deliberately made absent-flow cant-tell, so the new verb diverges by design while plan ready stays untouched. The verb must be CORE: the npm package ships bin/dist/skills only, extension discovery is cwd-only, and flow/plan are reserved extension names. Registration is one act module plus one app.ts line; exit mapping is status-only (ok/degraded 0, error 1, unconfigured 2). No flow validate/check verb exists today. Pre-plan rulings and s080 coordination: assets/design-constraints.md. Dogfood friction with repros: friction-log.md (F1 E304 bare create; F2 dd section asymmetry).

<a id="implementation-summary"></a>

## Implementation Summary

Three phases. Phase 1 bakes the builder flight-plan schema+template into the CLI as a bundled flow type (pattern: existing baked-content modules) and teaches flow create to resolve bundled types when --schema/--template are omitted; it also lands the known-bad fixtures (098-shaped: stray files only; 099-shaped: assets only; plan-without-flow; both-good) with a failing-first test for bare create. Phase 2 adds the check verb to the flow act family (acts/flow.ts, NOT the frozen acts/plan/index.ts), TDD red-first against those fixtures: clause 1 obtains plan validity via the plan validate --json envelope (CLI-is-the-API, s080 seam), clause 2 reads the flight plan via readFlowDoc; verdicts compose as plan-invalid=error(1), flow-missing-or-legacy=degraded(0) warning, both-good=ok(0); the envelope counts examined and excluded artifacts and its next_action carries the bare create invocation. Phase 3 writes the docs/how guide and the pij-facing contract, converges DELTA blocks into ermines stand-up.md branch, sends the handoff + collaboration offer via prime, and corrects the E304 one-liner on #140.
